spans.s:
m. (-हः)
1 Urinary disease, especially inflammatory affection of the urethra, including gonorrhoea, &c.
3 A ram.
4 Urine, piss.
E.
मिह to pass as urine, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्)
Urining, passing urine.
E.
मिह to urine, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Membrum virile.
2 Urine, piss.
3 Passing urine, pissing.
E.
मिह to urine, aff. ल्यट्.

Suffering from urinary affections.
E.
मेह, and इनि aff.
